svg.title: LFSR with x⁴ + x³ + 1
svg.desc: Four flops in a row, stage 1 to stage 4, which are state_q[0] to state_q[3]. At each step every bit moves to the next stage. Stage 4 and stage 3, the x^4 and x^3 terms, feed an XOR, whose output goes back into stage 1, the 1 term. value is all four bits.
svg.text: LFSR with x⁴ + x³ + 1: one shift per step
Every flop is clocked by clk, reset to its seed bit by rst_n, and enabled by step. Thick border: flop.
